title.en: Work e-mail only in the work repository

hints.tr: Önce `work` klasörüne gir. Orada `--global` yazmadan `git config` depo düzeyine yazar.
hints.en: First go into the `work` folder. There, `git config` without `--global` writes to the repository level.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı (komutları sırayla yaz):

```bash
cd work
git config user.email ada@company.example
git config --list --show-origin
```
hints.en:
The full solution (type the commands in order):

```bash
cd work
git config user.email ada@company.example
git config --list --show-origin
```

label.en: The global e-mail did not change
